commands.name: search-objects
commands.summary: Search V&A collection objects by keyword. Filters: maker, object name, material, place, accession number, category, place/material/technique/person/organisation/collection IDs, has-image and on-displa

commands.name: export-objects-csv
commands.summary: Export object search results as CSV text. Takes the same main filters as search-objects.

commands.name: get-object
commands.summary: Get the full catalogue record for one museum object by its system number (the digits after 'O', e.g. O151155 -> 151155).

commands.name: get-object-manifest
commands.summary: Get the IIIF presentation manifest (all images with their image service URLs) for an object.

commands.name: get-image-info
commands.summary: Get IIIF image info (dimensions, tile sizes, supported formats) for an image asset ID such as _primaryImageId.

commands.name: get-facet-counts
commands.summary: Get facet counts (categories, people, places, materials, techniques, etc.) for an object search.

commands.name: list-facet-values
commands.summary: List the values and counts of one facet type (e.g. place, material, category) for an object search. Use this to find facet IDs for search-objects.

commands.name: autocomplete-names
commands.summary: Search-as-you-type suggestions for people and organisations (makers), returning their IDs for use in id_person / id_organisation filters.

commands.name: search-archives
commands.summary: Search the V&A archives index (archive collections and records) by keyword.

commands.name: list-suggested-facets
commands.summary: List the site's built-in suggested facets (popular places, etc.) with their system-number IDs.

commands.name: list-organisations
commands.summary: List organisations in the collection A–Z for a given starting letter, with their organisation IDs and profile URLs.

commands.name: get-organisation-objects
commands.summary: Open an organisation profile page and list its featured collection objects.
